parameterMigrations.note: Replace numeric thinking budgets with thinking_level. Gemini 3.8 Flash supports low, medium, and high; medium is the default and minimal is unsupported.

notes: thinking_level=minimal is unsupported on Gemini 3.8 Flash and returns an error.
Remove temperature, top_p, and top_k when migrating to Gemini 3.8 Flash.
candidate_count is unsupported in Gemini 3 and later.
Prefilled model turns are unsupported; the final user turn must contain non-empty text.
GenerateContent FunctionResponse objects must include call_id and name.

Google documents caching as supported for Gemini 3.8 Flash; no dedicated caching field exists in the current CKB profile schema, so this remains source-backed note metadata rather than an inferred schema extension.

Google documents Batch API, Flex inference, and Priority inference as supported consumption options; CKB's current profile schema has no dedicated consumption-options fields, so these remain source-backed note metadata.
